channel.description: Recent content in Firewall on ProHomeLab – everything about homelab and self-hosting

item.title: Traefik on Its Own VLAN: Configuring the Firewall in OPNsense
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: I’m moving Traefik to a dedicated VLAN and restructuring my homelab network architecture: the reverse proxy becomes the central access point to services, while OPNsense controls network access between VLANs.

item.title: OPNsense 26.1: Installation and Setup from Scratch
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A practical guide to OPNsense 26.1 - installing on bare metal, configuring the firewall, GeoIP, FireHOL and CrowdSec, plus network monitoring and protecting your home lab.

item.title: How to Set Up a Firewall in Proxmox VE | Step-by-Step Guide
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to configuring Proxmox’s built-in firewall to protect virtual machines and containers. Covers creating rules, configuring network zones, traffic management, and recommendations for securing your cluster.

item.title: Proxmox SDN: A Complete Guide to Setup and Usage
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to configuring SDN in Proxmox for centralized management of virtual networks. Covers creating virtual network segments, configuring VXLAN, integrating with the firewall, and recommendations for managing network resources.

item.title: Installing and Configuring CrowdSec in an LXC Container Alongside Traefik
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring CrowdSec inside an LXC container. Covers the key steps from deployment to integrating server protection and activity monitoring, to quickly secure a virtualized environment.

item.title: CrowdSec in Docker: Installation and Server Protection Against Attacks
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed guide to installing and configuring CrowdSec in a Docker container. Covers the steps from deployment to integrating server protection and activity monitoring, to quickly secure your hosting and services.
